request: Analyze GSE235781 for PMID 38095016 (Fast and slow muscle fiber transcriptome dynamics with lifelong endurance exercise.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

accessions: GSE235781 (SubSeries of SuperSeries GSE236600; OH baseline samples deposited in sister SubSeries GSE130977)
final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of pooled single fibers (MHC I = SLOW, MHC IIa = FAST), vastus lateralis, NextSeq 500

time: POST (4 h after 3x10 knee extensions at 70% 1-RM)

final.repeated_measure_unit: subject (pre and post biopsies, both fiber types, from the same man)
final.primary_estimand: Acute resistance-exercise response (4 h POST vs PRE, within subject) of the transcriptome in fast and in slow fibers, separately for each cohort (LLE, YE, OH); fiber and cohort differences in that response are compared descriptively
planned_contrasts: FAST fibers POST vs PRE in LLE (abstract: exercise response, mainly metabolic)
FAST fibers POST vs PRE in YE (abstract: growth + metabolic signature)
FAST fibers POST vs PRE in OH (abstract: stress-related response)
SLOW fibers POST vs PRE in LLE (abstract: only LLE responded; ketone/lipid metabolism)
SLOW fibers POST vs PRE in YE (abstract: no biological response)
SLOW fibers POST vs PRE in OH (abstract: no biological response)
final.sample_inclusion: 25 men, 100 fiber-pool samples per GEO overall design; GSE235781 holds 81 (OH PRE samples are in GSE130977; YE subject 5 SLOW PRE absent)

paper_threshold.source_locator: abstract reports only 'P < 0.05' for biological responses, not a DEG rule

final.paper_results: No DEG counts or gene names in the abstract; fast fibers more responsive than slow in all cohorts; slow-fiber response only in LLE

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: No full text available; plan rebuilt from the PubMed abstract (PMID 38095016) and the GEO series/sample records of GSE235781 and SuperSeries GSE236600. The abstract describes pre/post 4 h resistance-exercise biopsies with fast and slow fiber RNA-seq in three cohorts, and response comparisons across fiber types and cohorts. It gives no DE method, threshold or counts.

checks: series title matches the paper's design (MHC I / MHC IIa fibers, lifelong exercise, resistance exercise)
matrix GSE235781_counts_geo.txt.gz is the only supplementary file; its 81 sample columns map one-to-one onto the 81 GSMs

ownership.reasoning: The series is linked to PMID 38095016 in GEO and the counts file is the series' own supplementary file.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are Sample_<grp>[M]_<subject><letter>_sequence.fastq.gz, where young and old-healthy columns carry an extra 'M' (YEM, OHM) that the GEO description field lacks (YE, OH). Both sides are reduced to the exact key <grp>_<subject><letter> (e.g. YE_1A) by regex, never by position. Letter A/B = SLOW PRE/POST and C/D = FAST PRE/POST per the titles. Subject ids restart at 1 in each cohort, so subj = <grp>_<id>. cell = fiber x cohort stratum.

final.source: GEO data_processing: featureCounts v1.5.0 -M --fraction -g gene_id; inspect integer_fraction 0.875 with fractional values

matrix.reasoning: featureCounts with -M --fraction assigns fractional counts to multimapping reads, so the matrix holds estimated read counts (mostly integers, some fractions), not FPKM/TPM. Rounding to integers for a count model is standard and documented.

design.subject: subj

not_estimable: FAST OH POST vs PRE and SLOW OH POST vs PRE: GSE235781 contains no OH PRE samples (they are in GSE130977, a separately processed earlier submission); not analyzed here

candidates.value: pool cohorts and fit time within fiber type
candidates.reason_rejected: the paper reports cohort-specific responses; pooling changes the estimand and would mix OH (POST only)
different SubSeries and processing run (per-sample featureCounts files from an earlier study); the request is GSE235781, and combining would confound OH baseline with batch
cross-sectional post-exercise comparison is not the exercise-response estimand

design.reasoning: Exercise effect = 4 h POST vs PRE within the same men, estimated separately in each fiber x cohort stratum, as the abstract describes responses per fiber type and per cohort. Four strata have both time points (n=8 pairs; SLOW YE has 7 complete pairs). The two OH strata have POST only in this series, so their planned contrasts cannot be estimated.

covariates.name: subj
covariates.disposition: blocking factor: pre and post biopsies come from the same man

covariance.reasoning: Repeated measures: each subject contributes a PRE and a POST sample within a fiber type, so subject is a blocking term. No batch or lane information is given; all samples are male.

paper_route.reason: abstract does not state the DE method

deviations: paper method unknown (abstract only); paired DESeq2 used as the validated count route
featureCounts fractional counts rounded to integers

method.reasoning: Estimated counts -> DESeq2 after rounding, subject-blocked paired design fitted separately per fiber x cohort stratum, incomplete pairs removed.

final.deviation_note: Abstract gives no DEG rule; BH padj < 0.05 without fold-change cutoff applied. Raw P < 0.05 reported only as an audit count because the abstract quotes 'P < 0.05'.

threshold.reasoning: No paper threshold available from the abstract.

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the abstract only (no full text): no paper DEG counts, method, or threshold to compare.
OH (old healthy) exercise responses not estimable from GSE235781: OH PRE samples are deposited in GSE130977.
SLOW YE stratum has 7 complete pairs (subject YE_5 SLOW PRE missing).
Matrix includes ERCC spike-ins and EBV features; left in.

study.reasoning: Paper method/threshold unknown, so the run is a declared deviation; qualitative check: abstract says fast fibers respond more than slow, and among slow fibers only LLE responds.

discrepancies.paper: GEO overall design: 100 samples (25 men x 2 fibers x 2 time points)
discrepancies.data: 81 samples in GSE235781; 18 OH PRE in GSE130977; YE 5 SLOW PRE absent
discrepancies.disposition: OH contrasts not estimated; SLOW YE run on 7 pairs

executions.name: SLOW_YE_POST_vs_PRE
executions.reasoning: YE slow-fiber exercise response, paired (7 complete pairs)
